name: wrap-up
description: End-of-session pass: consolidate memory into current-state notes, then clean up only this session's own debris and report what is still open.

session_notice.title: Show a notice when a session starts
session_notice.description: Print one to three lines at the start of a session when an earlier one left something behind: unindexed memory notes, a watcher still running, stale temp files, a schedule nobody removed, uncommitted work. Report-only — it changes nothing, adds nothing to Claude's context, and stays quiet when there is nothing to say. Off by default.
